about: Changing Taps: while armed and waiting for the first tap the prompt follows the new count (Swift numberOfTaps.didSet); otherwise it is left alone; and a change never completes a measurement or drops captured taps. Each case starts a fresh analyzer (1 tap, threshold −40) and runs its 'steps' through the app's own paths: {"settings": {type, measureFlc}} sets the measurement type (its saved name) and Measure FLC as Settings does; {"setTaps": n} changes Taps as the user does; {"newTap": true} starts a sequence; {"guitarTap": hz} finishes a guitar capture on a synthetic tap ringing at hz, one capture long (the analyzer's FFT size at 48 kHz); {"materialTap": {phase, hz}} finishes a material capture on a 0.5 s synthetic tap (phase L, C or FLC); {"accept": true} accepts the phase under review; {"redo": true} redoes it; {"advance": "tapCooldown" | "captureWindow" | seconds} feeds that much quiet audio. Synthetic taps are tooling/synthetic-tap. 'expect' after the last step: 'statusMessage', 'statusUnchangedByLastStep' (the last step left the status as it was), 'phase' (the material phase, by Swift's raw value), 'complete', 'detecting', 'capturedTaps' (taps held this sequence), 'numberOfTaps'. Expected values are Swift's.

cases.note: raising Taps while armed and waiting for the first tap refreshes the prompt
a change before any sequence leaves the prompt alone
at the start of a plate sequence the fL prompt names the new count

expect.statusMessage: Ready for fL tap (×3 each for L, C)

cases.note: with FLC on, the prompt names all three phases

expect.statusMessage: Ready for fL tap (×2 each for L, C, FLC)

cases.note: a brace gets the brace prompt, which names no phases
at a later phase (fC redone after L's taps) a change leaves the redo's instruction alone — a string the prompt for this phase would not be, so an overwrite shows

expect.statusMessage: Ready for fC tap — tap again

cases.note: lowering Taps to the number already captured does not complete the measurement
lowering it below the number captured neither completes nor drops taps
raising it keeps the taps already captured
